import HartshorneLib.Chapter4CanonicalDifferentials
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4DifferentialLattice

/-!
# Local regular differential lattices on a smooth curve

The natural map from the differentials of a smooth curve's local ring into
its rational differential space is injective. Its image is a free rank-one
module over the local ring, defined independently of any choice of generator.
These are the local lattices needed to assign orders to rational differentials;
the finite-support and canonical-divisor constructions are subsequent steps.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]

/-- The natural map from a stalk to the function field respects the
ground-field algebra structures induced by the structure morphism. -/
theorem stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower (x : X.left) :
    IsScalarTower k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField := by
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
  ext r
  change (X.left.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X.left) trivial).hom
      (X.left.overAlgebraMap k ⊤ r) =
    (X.left.presheaf.stalkSpecializes
      ((genericPoint_spec X.left).specializes trivial)).hom
      ((X.left.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial).hom (X.left.overAlgebraMap k ⊤ r))
  exact (X.left.presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes_apply (U := ⊤) (y := x) trivial
    ((genericPoint_spec X.left).specializes trivial) _).symm

attribute [local instance] stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

/-- Rational differentials regular at a point, as a submodule over its local
ring. This uses the natural differential map and no selected local basis. -/
def curveRegularDifferentialLattice (x : X.left) :
    Submodule (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (CurveRationalDifferentials X) :=
  regularDifferentialLattice k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField

/-- Smooth-curve local differentials embed into the rational differential
space. Smoothness supplies the torsion-freeness required by localization. -/
theorem curveDifferentialMap_injective [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]
    (x : X.left) :
    Function.Injective
      (KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField) := by
  letI := (smoothCurve_stalkDifferentials_free_rank_one X x).1
  exact differentialMap_injective_of_isFractionRing k
    (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField

/-- The natural identification of local differentials with their regular
lattice inside the function-field differential space. -/
def curveRegularDifferentialLatticeEquiv [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]
    (x : X.left) :
    CurveStalkDifferentials X x ≃ₗ[X.left.presheaf.stalk x]
      curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x :=
  LinearEquiv.ofInjective
    (KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField)
    (curveDifferentialMap_injective X x)

@[simp]
theorem curveRegularDifferentialLatticeEquiv_coe [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]
    (x : X.left) (ω : CurveStalkDifferentials X x) :
    (curveRegularDifferentialLatticeEquiv X x ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) =
      KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField ω := rfl

/-- At every point of a smooth integral curve, regular differentials form a
free rank-one lattice in the rational differential space. -/
theorem curveRegularDifferentialLattice_free_rank_one
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] (x : X.left) :
    Module.Free (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x) ∧
      Module.rank (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x) = 1 := by
  have h := smoothCurve_stalkDifferentials_free_rank_one X x
  letI := h.1
  let e := curveRegularDifferentialLatticeEquiv X x
  exact ⟨Module.Free.of_equiv e, e.rank_eq.symm.trans h.2⟩

end
end Hartshorne
